name: image-to-editable-pptx
description: Convert slide images into high-fidelity PPTX files with editable text and selected elements.

interface.shortDescription: Turn slide images into editable PPTX files.
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct a 1280×720 slide image as a high-fidelity PPTX with editable OCR text and only reliably extracted movable icons.
interface.defaultPrompt: Convert this slide image into a high-fidelity editable PPTX.
